fr.title: Loriot d'Europe
fr.extract: Le Loriot d'Europe est une espèce de passereaux entièrement migratrice de la famille des Oriolidae, réputée pour sa couleur et son chant.

en.title: Eurasian golden oriole
en.extract: The Eurasian golden oriole, also known as the common golden oriole, is a species of passerine bird, measuring approximately 24cm in length with a wingspan of 44-45cm, and the only Old World oriole breeding in Northern Hemisphere temperate regions. It is a summer migrant in Europe and the Palearctic and spends the winter season in central and southern Africa.
